profile_text.body:
Mercor is a San Francisco-based technology startup founded in 2023. Its site describes the company as organizing human intelligence to power the AI economy, saying it powers frontier research, AI benchmarks, and AI agent training at scale for top AI labs and enterprises. It also describes an APEX family of benchmarks that assesses whether frontier AI models can perform economically valuable tasks across professional services, medicine, and software engineering, and says it helps enterprises turn expertise into production AI and new revenue streams. The company is led by co-founders Brendan Foody, Adarsh Hiremath, and Surya Midha. Foody and Hiremath are co-chief executive officers, with Hiremath in that role since January 2026 after serving as chief technology officer from 2023 to 2026, and Midha is reported as chief operating officer.

The held facts record a trade secrets lawsuit, Scale AI, Inc. v. Mercor.io Corporation, in the District Court for the Northern District of California. They also note a Series B of $100 million at a $2 billion valuation led by Felicis, a Series C at $10 billion in October 2025, a run rate above $2 billion, a reported $20B valuation talks in July 2026, a Deeptune acquisition, and an early 2026 data breach and contractor lawsuits. The company is also recorded as Mercor.io Corporation and is listed on Wikidata as an American technology company.
